也正是在这样一个时间节点，我收到了贾永同志发来的书稿《AI时代的记者——一个新闻: It is precisely at such a moment in time that I received a manuscript from comrade Jia Yong titled "The Journalist in the AI Era—A Veteran Journalist's Hand-Written Notes on Human-Machine Collaboration"
这不是一本简单介绍AI工具如何使用的操作手册，而是一位新闻老兵面对智能时代大潮，: This is not a simple operating manual introducing how to use AI tools, but rather an answer given by a veteran journalist facing the tide of the intelligent era, grounded in over 40 years of news practice and drawing on samples from tens of millions of characters of human-machine dialogue, to the questions of "how humanity is human, how journalists are journalists, and how technology can serve the good"
作者没有把AI写成一个神秘莫测的“新物种”，也没有把它简单看作抢饭碗的“对手”: The author neither portrays AI as a mysterious "new species" nor simplistically treats it as a "rival" that steals jobs
他把AI放回新闻实践的现场，放回内容生产的流程，提出了一个朴素而深刻的判断：AI: He places AI back in the context of news practice, back into the workflow of content production, and makes a simple yet profound judgment: AI is not the subject, but a tool
书中，作者以新闻人的“四力”为根，提出脚力、眼力、脑力、笔力在AI时代的升维路径: In the book, drawing on journalists' "four capabilities," the author proposes the upgraded paths for leg power, eye power, brain power, and pen power in the AI era: leg power evolves from "going to the scene" to "omnidirectional perception," eye power from "seeing" to "seeing through," brain power from "thinking" to "thought," and pen power from "human-machine writing" to "expression of the soul"
在此基础上，他又进一步提出“合力、定力、活力”，构成AI时代新质记者的完整能力体: Building on this foundation, he further proposes "collaborative power, steadfast power, and dynamic power," constituting a complete capability system for the new-quality journalist in the AI era
AI可以帮助记者更快地搜索资料、更广地感知信息、更高效地形成初稿、更细致地校核文: AI can help journalists search for materials faster, perceive information more broadly, form drafts more efficiently, and review texts more meticulously, but it cannot replace journalists in going to the scene, cannot replace their judgment, cannot replace their value choices, and most importantly, cannot replace their accountability to history, to the people, and to the times
书中有一个给我留下深刻印象的比喻：AI可以造万千“子弹”，但扣动扳机的人，必须是: There is a metaphor in the book that left a deep impression on me: AI can produce myriad "bullets," but the person pulling the trigger must be the journalist themselves
越是在AI能够高速生成内容的时代，越需要新闻人守住事实的源头、价值的准星和责任的: The more capable AI becomes of rapidly generating content, the more journalists need to hold firm to the source of facts, the true north of values, and the bottom line of responsibility
由此延伸出的四道“不可让渡的边界”——现场不能让渡、意义不能让渡、价值不能让渡、: From this extends four "non-negotiable boundaries"—the scene cannot be relinquished, meaning cannot be relinquished, values cannot be relinquished, responsibility cannot be relinquished—establishing clear, rigid, and enduring industry red lines for content production and human-machine collaboration in the AI era
从更宽广的意义看，这本书也为人工智能治理提供了一个生动样本: From a broader perspective, this book also provides a vivid example for artificial intelligence governance
全球人工智能治理需要大量来自一线实践、具体行业、真实场景的经验总结: Global AI governance requires abundant experience summaries drawn from frontline practice, specific industries, and real-world scenarios
新闻行业是人工智能冲击最直接、感受最敏锐、风险最集中的领域之一: The news industry is one of the fields where artificial intelligence's impact is most direct, where the perception is most acute, and where the risks are most concentrated
这本书表面上写的是记者如何驾驭AI，深处讲的则是人在人工智能时代如何保持清醒、保: On the surface, this book is about how journalists master AI, but at its core, it addresses how people can maintain clarity, maintain agency, and preserve dignity in the age of artificial intelligence
面对人工智能，最好的态度，是主动拥抱、善于驾驭、守住边界、追求卓越: The best attitude toward artificial intelligence is to actively embrace it, skillfully master it, hold firm to boundaries, and pursue excellence
